'''September 2001 Meriden tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at DJ's Comics, Meriden, CT on 8 September 2001. [[Tom Hollingworth]] won it. It is known from Keith Henderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2962">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-15-revised-meriden-ct-9-8-01-cpa-apologyd2962/ revised-meriden-ct-9-8-01-cpa-apology], DeckTech (Keith "Tessek-CPA" Henderson, 15 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-15-revised-meriden-ct-9-8-01-cpa-apologyd2962/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 September 2001
* '''Site:''' DJ's Comics, Meriden, CT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Tom Hollingworth]]
